title: You Must See ‘You Can See Everything.’ Plus: Judd Apatow!
format: A full deep dive on the Fielder/Oppenheim Elizabeth Holmes documentary, bookended by a Narnia-trailer argument and a first-time sit-down with Judd Apatow.

segments.heading: Movie news
segments.note: trailers and the crowded release calendar

films.title: Narnia: The Magician's Nephew
films.note: Greta Gerwig trailer, set to Stairway to Heaven (a first-ever Zeppelin license), moves the story 50 years on to post-war England. Both balk at the CGI worlds; agree it's a kids' movie. Hits theaters Feb 12, Super Bowl weekend.

films.title: You Can See Everything
films.note: A24 documentary following Elizabeth Holmes and Billy Evans in the 34 days before prison, then two years into the recreations. Both call it the movie of the year; a verité first half flips into a metanarrative where Amanda Seyfried re-plays Holmes. Fielder as detective, not comic. Likely Best Picture, not doc-branch, contender.

films.title: Paralyzed by Hope: The Maria Bamford Story
films.note: Three years of following Bamford; shot cheap and self-financed to start. Became a relatable portrait of OCD, intrusive thoughts and mental-health survival.

films.title: Norm
films.note: Macdonald doc built entirely from archival, no talking heads, because no one could crack who Norm was. Ends on a Largo set turned tearful, before anyone knew he was sick.

films.title: The Comeback King
films.note: Apatow's next narrative feature, co-written with and starring Glenn Powell as a country star in free fall. Kristen Milioti and Madeleine Klein co-star.
